name: lifecycle-restart-safety
title: Lifecycle and restart safety
description: Implement the production allocation-free lifecycle reducer with boot-correlated reconstruction, fresh arming, restart inhibition and latched E-stop reset semantics.
creator: mj
notes: Software-only G2 child complete. control-core now owns one exhaustive direct-enum lifecycle reducer covering 8 states and 18 event kinds (144 diagnostic rows). A fresh process boot_id correlates reconstruction and operator events; strictly increasing reconstruction/operator sequences reject duplicate and reordered input, Start references the accepted Arm sequence, and fault clear matches the current fault generation. Unsafe reconstruction enters inhibited Fault. E-stop globally preempts every non-Shutdown state, advances an assertion generation, and requires matching current-boot release plus software reset. Reset preserves interrupted Boot/Fault prerequisites instead of bypassing them. Every Running exit synchronously orders CancelMission before ReleaseResources. Eleven lifecycle tests cover complete projections, stale boot/generations, loss/duplicate/reorder/timeout, restart from every state, deterministic replay/report/DOT and zero allocations. control-core has no statig dependency. Architecture check and tools/ci.sh passed. Physical actuation, target timing, systemd kill tests and Orange Pi qualification remain hardware/deployment gates.
